title: Windows-native CodegenTool snapshots omit the analyzer cache and stamp
body: A clean pinned Windows snapshot cannot materialize CodegenTool because unity-analyzer-stamp.py tries to copy SDFNodeGenerator.dll into the missing ignored RoslynAnalyzers cache/stamp path. This lane had to add the documented DisableUnityAnalyzerAutoDeploy consumer workaround in VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt; consolidate analyzer cache provisioning or make the snapshot contract explicit.

title: Native VIXEN witness queue must rebuild its deployed core after wrapper pin drift
body: The live with-test-lock wrapper refused the queued Release witness because managed/dist/box-queue-core.built-from was 28e016... while queue/core.pin required 2f98e18.... The documented recovery was to run the queued queue/build-core.sh bootstrap before the witness could start; make wrapper/core deployment self-healing or expose a preflight.
